summary: PR 7252 added Dynamic Data Masking capability to the document-db/database-account module. It was approved and merged with a major-style breaking change on serverless configuration.
proposed: The PR body states the goal as adding the ability to deploy Cosmos DB with Dynamic Data Masking.
changed: Per the CHANGELOG diff, the Microsoft.DocumentDB/* references were updated to 2026-04-01-preview, across the parent and its child modules (for example cassandra-keyspace and gremlin-database). Serverless moved from capabilitiesToAdd to a new capacityMode property because EnableServerless is not allowed in API versions beyond 2024-05-15-preview. Review comments from the author say test locations were switched after zonal-redundant capacity errors in West US 3 and East US 2.
shipped: PR 7252 merged document-db/database-account 0.21.0, with Dynamic Data Masking, the 2026-04-01-preview API update and the capacityMode breaking change. Child modules received 0.1.1 CHANGELOG entries for the API reference update.
